title: Bai Chay half day
summary: Sun World, Bai Chay Bridge, and the Quang Ninh Museum. This is the shore. The bay boat is a different day. Bai Tho stays off this walk.

stops.name: Sun World
stops.note: The cable ride is about 5 minutes. Weekday cable hours are 14:00–20:00, and Saturday–Sunday 09:00–20:00. Dragon Park and the water park are listed at 09:00–18:00, and a reseller line says those parks had stopped. Cable prices do not match: 380,000 / 280,000 đồng for 1 June–31 July 2026, child 1 m–1.4 m; adult 340,000 and child 250,000 on the airline sheet from 29 July 2026, VAT not included; adult two-way 380,000 for 1 October–31 December 2026. Combos are priced apart from the cable fare.

approach.note: About 9 km from the center, or 500 m from the passenger port. A taxi from the center is 100,000–200,000 đồng one way. Minutes are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Bai Chay Bridge
stops.note: The bridge between the shores. The walk minute, the length, the year, and the toll are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Quang Ninh Museum
stops.note: An adult ticket is 40,000 đồng. How long to allow is Check on arrival.
